title: Instant E-PAN User Manual | Income Tax Department

eligibility.value: All Individual taxpayers, who have not been allotted a Permanent Account Number (PAN) but possess Aadhaar
eligibility.quote: The Instant e-PAN service is available to all Individual taxpayers, who have not been allotted a Permanent Account Number (PAN) but possess Aadhaar.

eligibility.value: User not a minor as on date of request
eligibility.quote: User not a minor as on date of request;

eligibility.value: User not covered under the definition of Representative Assessee u/s 160 of the Income Tax Act
eligibility.quote: User not covered under the definition of Representative Assessee u/s 160 of the Income Tax Act.

fees.quote: Obtain digitally signed PAN in electronic format, free of cost, with the help of Aadhaar and your mobile number linked with Aadhaar

issuing_authority.quote: Instant E-PAN User Manual | Income Tax Department

steps.value: Go to the e-Filing portal homepage, click Instant e-PAN.
steps.quote: Go to the e-Filing portal homepage, click Instant e-PAN.

steps.value: On the e-PAN page, click Get New e-PAN.
steps.quote: On the e-PAN page, click Get New e-PAN.

steps.value: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number, select the I confirm that checkbox and click Continue.
steps.quote: On the Get New e-PAN page, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number, select the I confirm that checkbox and click Continue.

steps.value: On the OTP validation page, click I have read the consent terms and agree to proceed further and click Continue.
steps.quote: On the OTP validation page, click I have read the consent terms and agree to proceed further. Click Continue.

steps.value: Enter the 6-digit OTP received on the mobile number linked with Aadhaar, select the checkbox to validate the Aadhaar details with UIDAI and click Continue.
steps.quote: On the OTP validation page, enter the 6-digit OTP received on the mobile number linked with Aadhaar, select the checkbox to validate the Aadhaar details with UIDAI and click Continue.

steps.value: On the Validate Aadhaar Details page, select the I Accept that checkbox and click Continue.
steps.quote: On the Validate Aadhaar Details page, select the I Accept that checkbox and click Continue.

registration_steps.value: Click Register on the e-Filing portal homepage
registration_steps.quote: Do not have an account? Register
